jobs.title: Manager, Strategy Design and Delivery
jobs.description:
Position title: Manager, Strategy Design & Delivery Contract type / duration: 5-year fixed-term contract Location: Geneva Department: Strategy, Policy & Foresight Team: Strategy Design & Delivery Team Reports To: Head, Strategy Design & Delivery N° of positions supervised (if applicable): N/A Career Step: 3 1. About the Role The Strategy, Policy and Foresight Department serves as Gavi’s strategic compass – guiding the organisation through complexity with clarity, credibility, and collaboration. The department focuses on four work areas:
• Foresight: Ensuring the Alliance remains fit-for-purpose over the long term by anticipating trends, navigating uncertainty, and helping reshape the global health ecosystem.
• Strategy: Leading the development of Gavi’s five-year strategies (e.g. Gavi 6.0) and sub-strategies and getting them ready for roll-out, grounded in evidence, and responsive to country needs.
• Policy: Crafting evidence-based programmatic, funding and vaccine policies and investment cases that are country-driven, impactful, equitable, and resource-efficient.
• Delivery Acceleration: Accelerating the implementation of strategy delivery where cross-functional collaboration is essential to drive impact (e.g. programmatic ‘must wins’). Through its two teams - Strategy Design & Delivery Team (SDD) and Policy - the department operates with a structured, data-driven, and solution-oriented approach. The core objective of the role is to design and deliver high-impact strategic programmatic initiatives that shape Gavi’s future direction. The Manager will develop high-quality, evidence-based options and recommendations, facilitate stakeholder engagement across the Secretariat, Alliance and broader global health ecosystem, and ensure strategic priorities are translated into practical implementation plans. 2. Key Responsibilities Responsibilities include:
• Strategic analysis and option development: Prepare robust evidence bases, actionable options and recommendations, and implementation plans aligned with Gavi’s strategic priorities, working closely with cross-Secretariat project teams
• Senior decision-making support: Contribute to high-quality, insight-driven deliverables—including strategy documents, presentations and decision memos—for Gavi’s CEO, executive leadership, and Board
• Stakeholder engagement and alignment: Engage stakeholders across the Alliance and broader global health ecosystem at technical and leadership levels, facilitating transparent, inclusive processes and fostering alignment
• Implementation planning and delivery follow-through: Translate strategic priorities into practical implementation plans, including facilitating integration into Gavi Secretariat guidelines, processes, and programmes As examples, the questions that the Manager may work on include:
• What are the implications of key trends in the multilateral, global health and immunisation ecosystem for the Alliance’s long-term value proposition and operating model?
• How will Gavi adapt the Gavi 6.0 Strategy in light of shifting resource availability? What are the implications for strategy roll-out?
• How should Gavi’s approach to engaging the private sector evolve in Gavi 6.0?
• How will Gavi’s collaboration with the Global Fund and other global health institutions evolve in the context of the reshaping global health architecture?
• How will Gavi drive the deployment of a more effective, sustainable, and integrated model for delivering immunisation campaigns? Note: The essential functions listed in this section are not exhaustive of the job responsibilities; other duties may be assigned consistently with the department's needs. 3. Your Experience and Skills Professional Experience:
• At least 5 years of professional experience, including at least two years of experience in a top tier management consulting firm and/or at least two years of experience in the private sector required
• Significant experience in the field of strategy development is essential
• Experience in global health and/or the non-profit sector is an asset Education and Qualifications:
• Advanced degree in business administration, public health, epidemiology, medicine, public policy, economics, international development or equivalent required Technical and Functional Skills:
• Excellent analytical skills, including excellent knowledge of global health
• Structured strategic thinking
• Excellent project management skills
• Ability to manage stakeholders and influence outside of formal hierarchical structures
• Excellent writing, communication and presentation skills
• Confidence when dealing with senior leadership
• Ability to work independently, under pressure and with resilience, demonstrating initiative and flexibility Languages Needed:
• Fluent in English
• Other languages desirable, particularly French 4. How You Work (Behaviours and Mindsets)
• You are highly collaborative, building trust-based relationships across diverse teams, departments, and partner organisations to drive progress on complex, cross-cutting initiatives
• You communicate with clarity, navigating sensitive dynamics and influencing outcomes across a wide range of stakeholders
• You operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of your scope of work and driving it forward with structure and energy
• You thrive in complex, fast-evolving environments, demonstrating agility and judgment in the face of ambiguity and shifting priorities
• You demonstrate initiative and resilience under pressure, proactively identifying risks and proposing solutions to keep work on track
• You are able to work in a multicultural environment and establish harmonious working relationships with multiple teams
• You are mission-driven and delivery-oriented, maintaining focus on achieving tangible impact while upholding the highest standards of excellence

jobs.title: Manager, Policy
jobs.description:
Position title: Manager, Policy Contract type / duration: 5-year fixed-term contract Location: Geneva Department: Strategy, Policy & Foresight Team: Policy Team Reports To: Head, Policy N° of positions supervised (if applicable): 0 Career Step: 3 1. About the Role The Strategy, Policy and Foresight Department serves as Gavi’s strategic compass – guiding the organisation through complexity with clarity, credibility, and collaboration. The department focuses on four work areas:
• Foresight: Ensuring the Alliance remains fit-for-purpose over the long term by anticipating trends, navigating uncertainty, and helping reshape the global health ecosystem
• Strategy: Leading the development of Gavi’s five-year strategies (e.g. Gavi 6.0) and sub-strategies and getting them ready for roll-out, grounded in evidence, and responsive to country needs
• Policy: Crafting evidence-based programmatic, funding and vaccine policies and investment cases that are country-driven, impactful, equitable, and resource-efficient
• Delivery Acceleration: Accelerating the implementation of strategy delivery where cross-functional collaboration is essential to drive impact (e.g. programmatic ‘must-wins’) Through its two teams - Strategy Design & Delivery (SDD) and Policy - the department operates with a structured, data-driven, and solution-oriented approach. The core objective of the role is to design high-impact strategic programmatic and vaccine policies and investment cases that guide the scope, allocation and programming of Gavi’s funding, shaping Gavi’s future direction. The Manager, Policy will support the development of high-quality, evidence-based options and recommendations for senior decision-makers, oversee stakeholder engagement across the Secretariat, Alliance and broader global health ecosystem, and ensure policy priorities are translated into practical implementation plans. 2. Key Responsibilities The Manager, Policy leads the development of programmatic, funding and vaccine policies and investment cases that shape Gavi’s future direction. Responsibilities include:
• Work closely with cross-Secretariat project teams to deliver robust evidence bases, actionable options and recommendations, and implementation plans aligned with Gavi’s strategic priorities;
• Produce high-quality, insight-driven deliverables—including policy documents, presentations, decision memos and vaccine investment cases/assessments—for Gavi’s CEO, Senior Leadership Team, and Board;
• Coordinate stakeholder engagement across the Alliance at technical and leadership level, facilitating transparent, inclusive processes and fostering alignment across Secretariat teams, Alliance partners and senior leadership;
• Provide policy interpretation and translate policy priorities into practical implementation plans, including facilitating integration into Gavi Secretariat guidelines, processes, and programmes. As examples, the initiatives that the Manager will lead cover the following questions:
• What new vaccines from its current Vaccine Investment Strategy and its assessments of vaccines with epidemic and pandemic potential will Gavi adopt into its portfolio?
• What will be Gavi’s approach to identifying and prioritising new vaccine investments in future strategic periods?
• What is the design and roll-out plan for Vaccine Budgets in Gavi 6.0 that enable countries to maximise the impact on Gavi 6.0 Strategic Goals while strengthening predictable planning?
• How can the Alliance further transform its cash and partner funding architecture for countries to enable maximum impact on its strategic goals while increasing simplicity?
• What is Gavi’s approach to vaccine and other in-kind donations in Gavi 6.0? Note: The essential functions listed in this section are not exhaustive of the job responsibilities; other duties may be assigned consistently with the department’s needs. 3. Your Experience and Skills Work experience
• Typically 5 to 7 years of professional experience, including at least two years of professional experience in programme policy development and/or programme strategy design is required.
• Experience in global health, global development and/or the non-profit sector required.
• Experience in a leading management consulting firm and experience in the private sector (healthcare, impact investment or management consulting) a strong plus.
• Experience working with vaccines, immunisation or infectious diseases, understanding of epidemiology and work experience in developing countries a strong plus. Education and Qualifications
• Advanced degree in business administration, public health, epidemiology, medicine, public policy, economics, international development or equivalent required. Technical and Functional Skills
• Global Health knowledge: Excellent knowledge of global health institutions and the dynamics in the broader global health and development ecosystem.
• Strategy & Policy Development: Ability to structure and refine programmatic strategies, policies, and investment cases, translating evidence and stakeholder input into actionable options and recommendations aligned with the organisation’s strategic goals.
• Analytical Problem-Solving: Demonstrated capacity to break down complex issues, use qualitative/quantitative analysis (incl. for health economic and epidemiologic analysis), and develop evidence-based options for senior decision-makers, especially in global health or development settings.
• Preparation and Presentation of Insight-Driven Deliverables: Advanced skills in producing and presenting high-quality policy documents, presentations and memos for executive audiences (CEO, Board, Leadership Team), ensuring content is rigorous, clear, and decision-ready.
• Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation: Ability to coordinate and facilitate alignment across diverse stakeholders, fostering transparent, inclusive, and constructive processes. Demonstrated confidence and poise when engaging senior and C-suite leaders.
• Influencing: Ability to leverage soft influencing skills to build alignment, foster trust, and drive outcomes across all levels of the organisation, adaptable as needed in a multicultural environment.
• Change leadership: Proven ability to operationalise strategic and policy priorities by overseeing development of practical implementation plans, integrating them into processes and programmes, navigating resistance, tracking progress to outcomes, and aligning teams around new ways of working to achieve sustainable outcomes. Languages needed
• Fluent in English;
• Other languages desirable, particularly French. 4. How You Work (Behaviours and Mindsets)
• You are highly collaborative, building trust-based relationships across diverse teams, departments and partner organisations to drive progress on complex, cross-cutting initiatives;
• You communicate with clarity, confidence and diplomacy, navigating sensitive situations and positively influencing outcomes across a wide range of stakeholders, including at senior leadership and Board levels; You operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking full ownership of workstreams and driving them forward with structure, energy and accountability;
• You thrive in complex, fast-evolving environments, demonstrating agility and sound judgment in the face of ambiguity and shifting priorities;
• You consistently demonstrate strategic initiative, critical thinking, and resilience under pressure, proactively identifying risks and proposing solutions to keep work on track;
• You are able to work in a multicultural environment and establish harmonious working relationships with multiple teams;
• You are mission-driven and delivery-oriented, maintaining focus on achieving tangible impact while upholding the highest standards of excellence.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo di posizione: Manager, Policy Tipo di contratto / durata: contratto a 5 anni a tempo determinato Luogo: Ginevra Dipartimento: Strategia, Politica & Foresight Team: Policy Team Reports to: Head, Policy N° di posizioni supervisionate (se applicabile): 0 Carriera Passo: 3 1. The Strategy, Policy and Foresight Department serve come bussola strategica di Gavi – guidando l'organizzazione attraverso la complessità con chiarezza, credibilità e collaborazione. Il dipartimento si concentra su quattro aree di lavoro:
• Foresight: assicurarsi che l'Alleanza rimanga adatto a lungo termine anticipando le tendenze, navigando l'incertezza e aiutando a rimodellare l'ecosistema globale della salute
• Strategia: Condurre lo sviluppo delle strategie di cinque anni di Gavi (ad esempio Gavi 6.0) e substrategie e prepararle per il roll-out, messe a terra in evidenza e reattive alle esigenze del paese
• Politica: Creazione di politiche programmatiche, di finanziamento e di vaccino basate su prove e casi di investimento che sono stati guidati, impattati, equitable, e-efficiente di risorse
• Accelerazione della consegna: Accelerare l'implementazione della fornitura di strategia in cui la collaborazione interfunzionale è essenziale per l'impatto dell'azionamento (ad esempio "must-wins" programmatico) Attraverso i suoi due team - Strategy Design & Delivery (SDD) e Policy - il dipartimento opera con un approccio strutturato, orientato ai dati e orientato alla soluzione. L’obiettivo principale del ruolo è quello di progettare politiche strategiche programmatiche e vaccini ad alto impatto e casi di investimento che guidano la portata, l’assegnazione e la programmazione del finanziamento di Gavi, modellando la direzione futura di Gavi. Il Manager, Policy sosterrà lo sviluppo di opzioni e raccomandazioni basate su prove di alta qualità per i decisori senior, supervisionerà l'impegno degli stakeholder in tutta la Segreteria, l'Alleanza e l'ecosistema sanitario globale più ampio e assicurerà che le priorità politiche siano tradotte in piani pratici di attuazione. 2. Responsabilità chiave Il Manager, Policy conduce lo sviluppo di politiche programmatiche, di finanziamento e di vaccino e casi di investimento che modellano la direzione futura di Gavi. Le responsabilità includono:
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di progetto cross-Secretariat per fornire solide basi di prova, opzioni e raccomandazioni attuabili e piani di implementazione allineati con le priorità strategiche di Gavi;
• Produrre materiali di alta qualità, orientati agli insight, inclusi documenti politici, presentazioni, memo decisionale e casi/valutazioni di investimento dei vaccini, per il CEO di Gavi, Senior Leadership Team e Board;
• Coordinare l'impegno degli stakeholder in tutta l'Alleanza a livello tecnico e di leadership, facilitando processi trasparenti, inclusivi e promuovendo l'allineamento tra i team di segretariato, i partner dell'Alleanza e la leadership senior;
• Fornire l'interpretazione politica e tradurre le priorità politiche in piani di attuazione pratici, tra cui facilitare l'integrazione in linee guida, processi e programmi del segretariato Gavi. Come esempi, le iniziative che il Manager porterà riguardano le seguenti domande:
• Quali nuovi vaccini della sua attuale strategia di investimento vaccino e le sue valutazioni dei vaccini con epidemia e potenziale pandemico Gavi adottano nel suo portafoglio?
• Quale sarà l’approccio di Gavi all’identificazione e alla definizione di nuovi investimenti nel vaccino nei futuri periodi strategici?
• Qual è il piano di progettazione e roll-out per i bilanci vaccini in Gavi 6.0 che consente ai paesi di massimizzare l'impatto sugli obiettivi strategici di Gavi 6.0 rafforzando la pianificazione prevedibile?
• Come può l'Alleanza trasformare ulteriormente la sua architettura di finanziamento in denaro e partner per i paesi per consentire il massimo impatto sui suoi obiettivi strategici, aumentando la semplicità?
• Qual è l’approccio di Gavi al vaccino e altre donazioni in natura a Gavi 6.0? Nota: Le funzioni essenziali elencate in questa sezione non sono esaustive delle responsabilità del lavoro; altri compiti possono essere assegnati in modo coerente con le esigenze del dipartimento. 3. La tua esperienza di lavoro e competenze
• Tipicamente da 5 a 7 anni di esperienza professionale, tra cui almeno due anni di esperienza professionale nello sviluppo della politica di programma e/o nella progettazione di strategia di programma è richiesto.
• Esperienza nella salute globale, nello sviluppo globale e/o nel settore non profit richiesto.
• Esperienza in una società di consulenza manageriale leader e esperienza nel settore privato (assistenza sanitaria, investimento di impatto o consulenza di gestione) un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza di lavoro con vaccini, immunizzazione o malattie infettive, comprensione dell'epidemiologia e esperienza lavorativa nei paesi in via di sviluppo un vantaggio forte. Istruzione e qualificazione
• Laurea avanzata in amministrazione aziendale, sanità pubblica, epidemiologia, medicina, politica pubblica, economia, sviluppo internazionale o equivalente richiesto. Abilità tecniche e funzionali
• Conoscenza globale della salute: Ottima conoscenza delle istituzioni sanitarie globali e delle dinamiche nell'ecosistema globale della salute e dello sviluppo.
• Strategia & Policy Development: Capacità di strutturare e perfezionare le strategie, le politiche e i casi di investimento programmatici, traducendo le prove e l’ingresso degli stakeholder in opzioni e raccomandazioni attuabili allineate agli obiettivi strategici dell’organizzazione.
• Analitica Problem-Solving: Capacità dimostrata per abbattere problemi complessi, utilizzare analisi qualitative/quantitative (incl. per l'analisi economica e epidemiologica della salute), e sviluppare opzioni basate sulle prove per i decisori senior, in particolare nelle impostazioni di salute o sviluppo globali.
• Preparazione e presentazione di Insight-Driven Deliverables: competenze avanzate nella produzione e nella presentazione di documenti politici di alta qualità, presentazioni e promemoria per il pubblico esecutivo (CEO, Board, Leadership Team), assicurando che i contenuti siano rigorosi, chiari e pronti alle decisioni.
• Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation: Capacità di coordinare e facilitare l'allineamento tra i diversi stakeholder, promuovendo processi trasparenti, inclusi e costruttivi. Dimostrata fiducia e poise quando si impegnano leader senior e C-suite.
• Influenza: Capacità di sfruttare le competenze di influenza morbida per costruire allineamento, promuovere la fiducia e guidare i risultati in tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione, adattabile secondo le necessità in un ambiente multiculturale.
• Cambia la leadership: comprovata capacità di operativizzare le priorità strategiche e politiche, supervisionando lo sviluppo dei piani pratici di implementazione, integrandoli in processi e programmi, navigando la resistenza, tracciando i progressi verso i risultati, e allineando i team intorno a nuovi modi di lavorare per raggiungere risultati sostenibili. Lingue necessarie
• Fluente in inglese;
• Altre lingue desiderabili, in particolare francesi. 4. Come si lavora (Behaviours and Mindsets)
• Lei è altamente collaborativo, costruendo relazioni basate sulla fiducia in diversi team, reparti e organizzazioni partner per guidare i progressi su iniziative complesse e trasversale;
• Si comunica con chiarezza, fiducia e diplomazia, navigando situazioni sensibili e influenzando positivamente i risultati in una vasta gamma di stakeholder, tra cui a livello senior leadership e Board; Lei opera con un alto grado di autonomia, assumendo la piena proprietà dei flussi di lavoro e guidandoli in avanti con struttura, energia e responsabilità;
• Si prospera in ambienti complessi e in rapida evoluzione, dimostrando agilità e giudizio sonoro di fronte all'ambiguità e alle priorità mobili;
• Lei dimostra costantemente l'iniziativa strategica, il pensiero critico e la resilienza sotto pressione, identificando proattivamente i rischi e proponendo soluzioni per mantenere il lavoro in pista;
• Siete in grado di lavorare in un ambiente multiculturale e stabilire relazioni di lavoro armoniose con più squadre;
• Siete guidati dalla missione e orientati alla consegna, mantenendo l'attenzione sul raggiungimento dell'impatto tangibile, mantenendo i più elevati standard di eccellenza.

Position title: Manager, Policy Contract type / duration: 5-year fixed-term contract Location: Geneva Department: Strategy, Policy & Foresight Team: Policy Team Reports To: Head, Policy N° of positions supervised (if applicable): 0 Career Step: 3 1. About the Role The Strategy, Policy and Foresight Department serves as Gavi’s strategic compass – guiding the organisation through complexity with clarity, credibility, and collaboration. The department focuses on four work areas:
• Foresight: Ensuring the Alliance remains fit-for-purpose over the long term by anticipating trends, navigating uncertainty, and helping reshape the global health ecosystem
• Strategy: Leading the development of Gavi’s five-year strategies (e.g. Gavi 6.0) and sub-strategies and getting them ready for roll-out, grounded in evidence, and responsive to country needs
• Policy: Crafting evidence-based programmatic, funding and vaccine policies and investment cases that are country-driven, impactful, equitable, and resource-efficient
• Delivery Acceleration: Accelerating the implementation of strategy delivery where cross-functional collaboration is essential to drive impact (e.g. programmatic ‘must-wins’) Through its two teams - Strategy Design & Delivery (SDD) and Policy - the department operates with a structured, data-driven, and solution-oriented approach. The core objective of the role is to design high-impact strategic programmatic and vaccine policies and investment cases that guide the scope, allocation and programming of Gavi’s funding, shaping Gavi’s future direction. The Manager, Policy will support the development of high-quality, evidence-based options and recommendations for senior decision-makers, oversee stakeholder engagement across the Secretariat, Alliance and broader global health ecosystem, and ensure policy priorities are translated into practical implementation plans. 2. Key Responsibilities The Manager, Policy leads the development of programmatic, funding and vaccine policies and investment cases that shape Gavi’s future direction. Responsibilities include:
• Work closely with cross-Secretariat project teams to deliver robust evidence bases, actionable options and recommendations, and implementation plans aligned with Gavi’s strategic priorities;
• Produce high-quality, insight-driven deliverables—including policy documents, presentations, decision memos and vaccine investment cases/assessments—for Gavi’s CEO, Senior Leadership Team, and Board;
• Coordinate stakeholder engagement across the Alliance at technical and leadership level, facilitating transparent, inclusive processes and fostering alignment across Secretariat teams, Alliance partners and senior leadership;
• Provide policy interpretation and translate policy priorities into practical implementation plans, including facilitating integration into Gavi Secretariat guidelines, processes, and programmes. As examples, the initiatives that the Manager will lead cover the following questions:
• What new vaccines from its current Vaccine Investment Strategy and its assessments of vaccines with epidemic and pandemic potential will Gavi adopt into its portfolio?
• What will be Gavi’s approach to identifying and prioritising new vaccine investments in future strategic periods?
• What is the design and roll-out plan for Vaccine Budgets in Gavi 6.0 that enable countries to maximise the impact on Gavi 6.0 Strategic Goals while strengthening predictable planning?
• How can the Alliance further transform its cash and partner funding architecture for countries to enable maximum impact on its strategic goals while increasing simplicity?
• What is Gavi’s approach to vaccine and other in-kind donations in Gavi 6.0? Note: The essential functions listed in this section are not exhaustive of the job responsibilities; other duties may be assigned consistently with the department’s needs. 3. Your Experience and Skills Work experience
• Typically 5 to 7 years of professional experience, including at least two years of professional experience in programme policy development and/or programme strategy design is required.
• Experience in global health, global development and/or the non-profit sector required.
• Experience in a leading management consulting firm and experience in the private sector (healthcare, impact investment or management consulting) a strong plus.
• Experience working with vaccines, immunisation or infectious diseases, understanding of epidemiology and work experience in developing countries a strong plus. Education and Qualifications
• Advanced degree in business administration, public health, epidemiology, medicine, public policy, economics, international development or equivalent required. Technical and Functional Skills
• Global Health knowledge: Excellent knowledge of global health institutions and the dynamics in the broader global health and development ecosystem.
• Strategy & Policy Development: Ability to structure and refine programmatic strategies, policies, and investment cases, translating evidence and stakeholder input into actionable options and recommendations aligned with the organisation’s strategic goals.
• Analytical Problem-Solving: Demonstrated capacity to break down complex issues, use qualitative/quantitative analysis (incl. for health economic and epidemiologic analysis), and develop evidence-based options for senior decision-makers, especially in global health or development settings.
• Preparation and Presentation of Insight-Driven Deliverables: Advanced skills in producing and presenting high-quality policy documents, presentations and memos for executive audiences (CEO, Board, Leadership Team), ensuring content is rigorous, clear, and decision-ready.
• Stakeholder Engagement and Facilitation: Ability to coordinate and facilitate alignment across diverse stakeholders, fostering transparent, inclusive, and constructive processes. Demonstrated confidence and poise when engaging senior and C-suite leaders.
• Influencing: Ability to leverage soft influencing skills to build alignment, foster trust, and drive outcomes across all levels of the organisation, adaptable as needed in a multicultural environment.
• Change leadership: Proven ability to operationalise strategic and policy priorities by overseeing development of practical implementation plans, integrating them into processes and programmes, navigating resistance, tracking progress to outcomes, and aligning teams around new ways of working to achieve sustainable outcomes. Languages needed
• Fluent in English;
• Other languages desirable, particularly French. 4. How You Work (Behaviours and Mindsets)
• You are highly collaborative, building trust-based relationships across diverse teams, departments and partner organisations to drive progress on complex, cross-cutting initiatives;
• You communicate with clarity, confidence and diplomacy, navigating sensitive situations and positively influencing outcomes across a wide range of stakeholders, including at senior leadership and Board levels; You operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking full ownership of workstreams and driving them forward with structure, energy and accountability;
• You thrive in complex, fast-evolving environments, demonstrating agility and sound judgment in the face of ambiguity and shifting priorities;
• You consistently demonstrate strategic initiative, critical thinking, and resilience under pressure, proactively identifying risks and proposing solutions to keep work on track;
• You are able to work in a multicultural environment and establish harmonious working relationships with multiple teams;
• You are mission-driven and delivery-oriented, maintaining focus on achieving tangible impact while upholding the highest standards of excellence.

Positionstitel: Manager, Policy Contract Art / Duration: 5-Jahres-Befristung Location: Geneva Department: Strategy, Policy & Foresight Team: Policy Team Reports To: Head, Policy N° of position supervised (falls zutreffend): 0 Karriereschritt: 3 1. Die Abteilung Strategie, Politik und Vorausschau dient als strategischer Kompass von Gavi - sie führt die Organisation durch Komplexität mit Klarheit, Glaubwürdigkeit und Zusammenarbeit. Die Abteilung konzentriert sich auf vier Arbeitsbereiche:
• Vorausschau: Sicherstellen, dass die Allianz langfristig ihren Zweck erfüllt, indem sie Trends antizipiert, Unsicherheit navigiert und zur Neugestaltung des globalen Gesundheitsökosystems beiträgt
• Strategie: Führen der Entwicklung von Gavis Fünfjahresstrategien (z. B. Gavi 6.0) und Teilstrategien und bereiten sie auf den Roll-out vor, basierend auf Beweisen und auf die Bedürfnisse des Landes.
• Politik: Evidenzbasierte programmatische, Finanzierungs- und Impfstoffpolitik und Investitionsfälle erstellen, die länderorientiert, wirkungsvoll, gerecht und ressourceneffizient sind
• Delivery Acceleration: Beschleunigung der Umsetzung der Strategie Delivery, bei der funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit unerlässlich ist, um die Wirkung zu steigern (z. B. programmatische „Must-Wins) Durch seine beiden Teams - Strategy Design & Delivery (SDD) und Policy - arbeitet die Abteilung mit einem strukturierten, datengesteuerten und lösungsorientierten Ansatz. Das Hauptziel der Rolle ist es, strategische Programm- und Impfstrategien sowie Investitionsfälle zu entwickeln, die den Umfang, die Zuweisung und die Programmierung der Gavi-Finanzierung bestimmen und die zukünftige Ausrichtung von Gavi bestimmen. Der Manager, Policy, wird die Entwicklung hochwertiger, evidenzbasierter Optionen und Empfehlungen für leitende Entscheidungsträger unterstützen, das Engagement der Stakeholder im Sekretariat, in der Allianz und im weiteren globalen Gesundheitsökosystem überwachen und sicherstellen, dass die politischen Prioritäten in praktische Umsetzungspläne umgesetzt werden. 2. Hauptverantwortung Der Manager, Policy leitet die Entwicklung von programmatischen, Finanzierungs- und Impfstoffrichtlinien und Investitionsfällen, die die zukünftige Ausrichtung von Gavi prägen. Zu den Aufgaben gehören:
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projektteams des Sekretariats, um robuste Evidenzbasen, umsetzbare Optionen und Empfehlungen sowie Umsetzungspläne im Einklang mit den strategischen Prioritäten von Gavi zu liefern;
• Erstellung qualitativ hochwertiger, auf Erkenntnisse ausgerichteter Ergebnisse – einschließlich politischer Dokumente, Präsentationen, Entscheidungsmemos und Impfinvestitionsfälle/-bewertungen – für Gavis CEO, Senior Leadership Team und den Vorstand;
• Koordinierung des Engagements der Stakeholder im gesamten Bündnis auf technischer und Führungsebene, Erleichterung transparenter, integrativer Prozesse und Förderung der Abstimmung zwischen den Sekretariatsteams, den Allianzpartnern und den Führungskräften;
• Politische Interpretation und Umsetzung politischer Prioritäten in praktische Umsetzungspläne, einschließlich der Erleichterung der Integration in die Richtlinien, Prozesse und Programme des Gavi-Sekretariats. Als Beispiele behandeln die Initiativen, die der Manager leiten wird, die folgenden Fragen:
• Welche neuen Impfstoffe aus seiner aktuellen Impfanlagestrategie und seinen Bewertungen von Impfstoffen mit epidemischem und pandemischem Potenzial wird Gavi in sein Portfolio aufnehmen?
• Wie wird Gavis Ansatz zur Identifizierung und Priorisierung neuer Impfstoffinvestitionen in zukünftigen strategischen Perioden aussehen?
• Was ist der Entwurfs- und Einführungsplan für Impfbudgets in Gavi 6.0, der es den Ländern ermöglicht, die Auswirkungen auf die strategischen Ziele von Gavi 6.0 zu maximieren und gleichzeitig die vorhersehbare Planung zu stärken?
• Wie kann die Allianz ihre Bargeld- und Partnerfinanzierungsarchitektur für Länder weiter verändern, um maximale Auswirkungen auf ihre strategischen Ziele zu erzielen und gleichzeitig die Einfachheit zu erhöhen?
• Was ist Gavis Ansatz für Impfstoffe und andere Sachspenden in Gavi 6.0? Hinweis: Die in diesem Abschnitt aufgeführten wesentlichen Funktionen sind nicht erschöpfend für die Aufgaben; andere Aufgaben können im Einklang mit den Bedürfnissen der Abteilung zugewiesen werden. 3. Ihre Erfahrung und Fähigkeiten Arbeitserfahrung
• In der Regel sind 5 bis 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung, darunter mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Programmpolitik und / oder Programmstrategien erforderlich.
• Erfahrung in globaler Gesundheit, globaler Entwicklung und/oder im gemeinnützigen Sektor erforderlich.
• Erfahrung in einer führenden Managementberatung und Erfahrung im privaten Sektor (Healthcare, Impact Investment oder Management Consulting) ein starkes Plus.
• Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Impfstoffen, Immunisierung oder Infektionskrankheiten, Verständnis der Epidemiologie und Arbeitserfahrung in Entwicklungsländern ein starkes Plus. Ausbildung und Qualifikationen
• Erweiterter Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, öffentliche Gesundheit, Epidemiologie, Medizin, öffentliche Politik, Wirtschaft, internationale Entwicklung oder gleichwertig erforderlich. Technische und funktionale Fähigkeiten
• Globales Gesundheitswissen: Ausgezeichnetes Wissen über globale Gesundheitsinstitutionen und die Dynamik im breiteren globalen Gesundheits- und Entwicklungsökosystem.
• Strategie & Politikentwicklung: Fähigkeit, programmatische Strategien, Richtlinien und Investitionsfälle zu strukturieren und zu verfeinern, um Evidenz und Stakeholder-Input in umsetzbare Optionen und Empfehlungen zu übersetzen, die auf die strategischen Ziele der Organisation ausgerichtet sind.
• Analytisches Problemlösen: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, komplexe Probleme aufzuschlüsseln, qualitative / quantitative Analysen (einschließlich für gesundheitsökonomische und epidemiologische Analysen) zu verwenden und evidenzbasierte Optionen für leitende Entscheidungsträger zu entwickeln, insbesondere in globalen Gesundheits- oder Entwicklungsumgebungen.
• Vorbereitung und Präsentation von Insight-Driven Deliverables: Fortgeschrittene Fähigkeiten bei der Erstellung und Präsentation hochwertiger politischer Dokumente, Präsentationen und Memos für Führungskräfte (CEO, Board, Leadership Team), um sicherzustellen, dass der Inhalt streng, klar und entscheidungsbereit ist.
• Stakeholder-Engagement und -Fazilisierung: Fähigkeit, die Ausrichtung zwischen verschiedenen Stakeholdern zu koordinieren und zu erleichtern und transparente, integrative und konstruktive Prozesse zu fördern. Demonstrierte Vertrauen und Haltung beim Engagement von Führungskräften und C-Suite.
• Einflussnahme: Fähigkeit, Soft-Influencer-Fähigkeiten zu nutzen, um eine Ausrichtung aufzubauen, Vertrauen zu fördern und Ergebnisse auf allen Ebenen des Unternehmens zu erzielen, die sich nach Bedarf in einem multikulturellen Umfeld anpassen lassen.
• Change Leadership: Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, strategische und politische Prioritäten zu operationalisieren, indem sie die Entwicklung praktischer Umsetzungspläne überwachen, sie in Prozesse und Programme integrieren, Widerstand steuern, Fortschritte zu Ergebnissen verfolgen und Teams auf neue Wege ausrichten, um nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Sprachen benötigt
• fließend in Englisch;
• Andere Sprachen wünschenswert, vor allem Französisch. 4. Wie Sie arbeiten (Verhalten und Mindsets)
• Sie arbeiten eng zusammen und bauen vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zwischen verschiedenen Teams, Abteilungen und Partnerorganisationen auf, um Fortschritte bei komplexen, übergreifenden Initiativen zu erzielen.
• Sie kommunizieren mit Klarheit, Vertrauen und Diplomatie, navigieren in sensiblen Situationen und beeinflussen positiv die Ergebnisse in einem breiten Spektrum von Interessengruppen, auch auf Führungsebene und Vorstandsebene; Sie arbeiten mit einem hohen Maß an Autonomie, übernehmen die volle Verantwortung für Workstreams und treiben sie mit Struktur, Energie und Rechenschaftspflicht voran.
• Sie gedeihen in komplexen, sich schnell entwickelnden Umgebungen und zeigen Agilität und fundiertes Urteilsvermögen angesichts von Mehrdeutigkeiten und sich verändernden Prioritäten;
• Sie zeigen konsequent strategische Initiative, kritisches Denken und Widerstandsfähigkeit unter Druck, identifizieren proaktiv Risiken und schlagen Lösungen vor, um die Arbeit auf Kurs zu halten;
• Sie sind in der Lage, in einem multikulturellen Umfeld zu arbeiten und harmonische Arbeitsbeziehungen mit mehreren Teams aufzubauen;
• Sie sind missionsorientiert und lieferungsorientiert und konzentrieren sich weiterhin auf die Erreichung greifbarer Auswirkungen bei gleichzeitiger Einhaltung der höchsten Standards für Exzellenz.

Titre du poste : Gestionnaire, Politique Type de contrat / durée : Contrat à durée déterminée de 5 ans Lieu : Genève Ministère : Stratégie, Politique et prospective Équipe : Politiques Équipe Rapports À : Chef, Politique Nbre de postes supervisés (le cas échéant) : 0 Étape de carrière : 3 1. À propos du rôle Le département Stratégie, politique et prospective sert de boussole stratégique de Gavi, guidant l'organisation par la complexité avec clarté, crédibilité et collaboration. Le Ministère se concentre sur quatre domaines de travail :
• Prospective : Veiller à ce que l'Alliance reste apte à l'emploi à long terme en anticipant les tendances, en naviguant dans l'incertitude et en aidant à remodeler l'écosystème sanitaire mondial
• Stratégie : Diriger l'élaboration des stratégies quinquennales de Gavi (p. ex. Gavi 6.0) et des sous-stratégies et les préparer à la mise en oeuvre, en se fondant sur des preuves et en répondant aux besoins des pays
• Politiques : Élaboration de politiques de programmation, de financement et de vaccination fondées sur des données factuelles et de cas d ' investissement qui sont axés sur les pays, qui ont un impact, qui sont équitables et qui sont efficaces sur le plan des ressources
• Accélération de la mise en œuvre: Accélérer la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d'exécution où la collaboration interfonctionnelle est essentielle pour stimuler l'impact (par exemple, les programmes doivent gagner) Par l'intermédiaire de ses deux équipes - Conception et exécution de la stratégie (SDD) et Politique - le Ministère fonctionne selon une approche structurée, axée sur les données et axée sur les solutions. L'objectif principal de ce rôle est de concevoir des politiques stratégiques en matière de programmes et de vaccins à impact élevé et des cas d'investissement qui guident la portée, l'allocation et la programmation du financement de Gavi, et façonnent l'orientation future de Gavi. Le gestionnaire, Politiques, appuiera l'élaboration d'options et de recommandations de haute qualité fondées sur des données probantes à l'intention des décideurs supérieurs, supervisera l'engagement des intervenants à l'échelle du Secrétariat, de l'Alliance et de l'écosystème global de la santé, et veillera à ce que les priorités stratégiques soient traduites en plans de mise en oeuvre pratiques. 2. Principales responsabilités Le gestionnaire de la politique dirige l'élaboration de politiques de programmes, de financement et de vaccins et de cas d'investissement qui façonnent l'orientation future de Gavi. Les responsabilités comprennent :
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de projet intersecrétariats afin de fournir des bases solides de données probantes, des options et recommandations réalisables et des plans de mise en œuvre conformes aux priorités stratégiques de Gavi.
• Produire des produits livrables de haute qualité, axés sur les connaissances — y compris des documents stratégiques, des présentations, des notes de décision et des cas/évaluations d'investissement dans les vaccins — pour Gavis, chef de la direction de l'équipe de direction principale, et le conseil d'administration;
• Coordonner l'engagement des parties prenantes à l'échelle de l'Alliance au niveau technique et de la direction, en facilitant des processus transparents et inclusifs et en favorisant l'harmonisation entre les équipes du Secrétariat, les partenaires de l'Alliance et les cadres supérieurs;
• Fournir une interprétation des politiques et traduire les priorités en plans de mise en œuvre concrets, notamment en facilitant leur intégration dans les directives, processus et programmes du Secrétariat de Gavi. À titre d'exemple, les initiatives que dirigera le gestionnaire couvrent les questions suivantes :
• Quels nouveaux vaccins issus de sa stratégie d'investissement en vaccins et de ses évaluations des vaccins à risque d'épidémie et de pandémie vont être adoptés par Gavi dans son portefeuille?
• Quelle sera l'approche de Gavi pour identifier et hiérarchiser les nouveaux investissements dans les vaccins dans les périodes stratégiques futures?
• Quel est le plan de conception et de déploiement des budgets des vaccins à Gavi 6.0 qui permet aux pays de maximiser l'impact sur les objectifs stratégiques de Gavi 6.0 tout en renforçant une planification prévisible?
• Comment l'Alliance peut-elle transformer davantage son architecture de financement de fonds et de partenaires pour les pays afin de maximiser l'impact sur ses objectifs stratégiques tout en augmentant la simplicité?
• Quelle est l'approche de Gavis pour les vaccins et autres dons en nature dans Gavi 6.0? Remarque : Les fonctions essentielles énumérées dans cette section ne sont pas exhaustives des responsabilités professionnelles; d'autres fonctions peuvent être assignées de façon cohérente avec les besoins du ministère. 3. Votre expérience et vos compétences Expérience professionnelle
• En règle générale, il faut compter de 5 à 7 ans d ' expérience professionnelle, y compris au moins deux ans d ' expérience professionnelle dans l ' élaboration des politiques et/ou la conception des stratégies de programme.
• Expérience de la santé mondiale, du développement mondial et/ou du secteur sans but lucratif requis.
• Expérience dans une entreprise de conseil en gestion de premier plan et expérience dans le secteur privé (soins de santé, investissement impact ou conseil en gestion) un plus fort.
• Expérience de travail avec les vaccins, la vaccination ou les maladies infectieuses, compréhension de l'épidémiologie et expérience de travail dans les pays en développement un plus fort. Éducation et qualifications
• Diplôme avancé en administration des affaires, santé publique, épidémiologie, médecine, politique publique, économie, développement international ou équivalent requis. Compétences techniques et fonctionnelles
• Connaissance de la santé mondiale : Excellente connaissance des institutions de santé mondiale et de la dynamique de l'écosystème global de santé et de développement.
• Développement de la stratégie et des politiques : Capacité de structurer et d'affiner les stratégies programmatiques, les politiques et les cas d'investissement, en traduisant les données probantes et les contributions des parties prenantes en options et recommandations réalisables alignées sur les objectifs stratégiques de l'organisation.
• Analyse des problèmes : Capacité démontrée de décomposer des questions complexes, d'utiliser une analyse qualitative/quantitative (y compris pour l'analyse économique et épidémiologique de la santé) et d'élaborer des options fondées sur des données probantes pour les décideurs de haut niveau, en particulier dans les contextes mondiaux de santé ou de développement.
• Préparation et présentation des produits livrables d'Insight-Drive: Compétences avancées dans la production et la présentation de documents de politique, de présentations et de notes de service de haute qualité pour le public de la direction (CEO, conseil, équipe de leadership), en veillant à ce que le contenu soit rigoureux, clair et prêt à prendre des décisions.
• Engagement et facilitation des intervenants : Capacité de coordonner et de faciliter l'harmonisation entre les divers intervenants, en favorisant des processus transparents, inclusifs et constructifs. Faire preuve de confiance et de retenue lorsqu'il s'agit d'engager des cadres supérieurs et des chefs de C-suite.
• Influencer : Capacité de tirer parti des compétences qui influent sur le plan souple pour établir l'alignement, favoriser la confiance et stimuler les résultats à tous les niveaux de l'organisation, adaptable selon les besoins dans un environnement multiculturel.
• Leadership du changement : Capacité éprouvée de concrétiser les priorités stratégiques et politiques en supervisant l'élaboration de plans de mise en œuvre pratiques, en les intégrant dans les processus et les programmes, en naviguant sur la résistance, en suivant les progrès accomplis et en alignant les équipes sur de nouvelles façons de travailler pour obtenir des résultats durables. • Vous communiquez avec clarté, confiance et diplomatie, naviguant dans des situations délicates et influençant positivement les résultats d'un large éventail d'intervenants, y compris les cadres supérieurs et les conseils d'administration; Vous travaillez avec un degré élevé d'autonomie, en prenant la pleine propriété des flux de travail et en les faisant avancer avec la structure, l'énergie et la responsabilité;
• Vous prospèrez dans des environnements complexes et en évolution rapide, démontrant votre agilité et votre jugement éclairé face à l'ambiguïté et aux priorités changeantes;
• Vous faites preuve d'initiative stratégique, de pensée critique et de résilience sous pression, identifiez les risques de façon proactive et proposez des solutions pour maintenir le travail sur la bonne voie;
• Vous pouvez travailler dans un environnement multiculturel et établir des relations de travail harmonieuses avec plusieurs équipes;
• Vous êtes axé sur la mission et la prestation, en continuant de vous concentrer sur l'obtention d'un impact tangible tout en respectant les normes d'excellence les plus élevées.
